15 more Biranganas get FF status
2017-07-10T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/more-biranganas-get-ff-status-1430875

Fifteen more Biranganas (war heroines) have been recognised as freedom fighters for their contribution in the country's Liberation War in 1971.

The Ministry of Liberation War Affairs issued a gazette notification in this regard yesterday. With this, a total of 185 Biranganas received the freedom fighter status.

The liberation war affairs ministry, for the first time, recognised 41 Biranganas as freedom fighters on October 12, 2015.

Once recognised, the Biranganas will receive the same benefits as the freedom fighters do -- a monthly allowance, two annual bonus, special quotas in the government jobs and benefits for their children and grandchildren.
